title: From his first ball to Peninsula Arsenal White
body:
Yash has loved soccer for as long as I can remember. As a little boy, he was always curious and always outside, especially if there was a ball. He started playing at three, went to summer camps every year, and has grown so much since then.

He's an all-round sports kid too — he loves skiing, swimming, ice-skating, volleyball, cricket and badminton. But soccer will always be his favorite.

Now he wears jersey #38 for Peninsula Arsenal White, and I'm proud to be his #1 fan. Welcome to his journey!

— Mom
